purpose: First canonical poses for the fourteen original Tier 2 Triassic plant and prop subjects; awaiting human greenlight.
format: 2048x2048 PNG, isolated complete subject on pale neutral studio gray

encrinus.prompt: Full side-on Encrinus from rootlike holdfast through segmented column to one open ten-armed featherlike crown; Muschelkalk sea-lily anatomy, no flower or scenery.

encrinus-litter.prompt: High three-quarter low patch of loose star-centered crinoid columnals and short articulated stem fragments with a readable footprint; no living crown.

diplopora.prompt: Complete Diplopora calcified algal tuft: clustered cylindrical axes with orderly whorls of short radial branchlets and one holdfast; not a land plant or coral.

thecosmilia.prompt: Phaceloid Thecosmilia colony of separate unbranched parallel-to-diverging limestone corallite tubes, each ending in a star-septate calice; no trunk, foliage or green buds.

calcisponge.prompt: Complete Triassic calcareous sponge with broad encrusting holdfast and irregular stack of porous bulbous chambers with visible excurrent openings.

placunopsis-mound.prompt: High three-quarter plan view of a low broad Placunopsis bioherm made from hundreds of overlapping thin oyster-like shells with readable footprint.

daonella-bed.prompt: High three-quarter plan view of a thin dark shale slab densely covered in overlapping flat fan-shaped ribbed Daonella shells.

brachiopod-cluster.prompt: Compact cluster of eight to twelve biconvex bilaterally symmetrical Coenothyris lampshells attached around a low shared base.

cidaris.prompt: One complete Triassic cidaroid urchin with orderly test plates, sparse long club-shaped primary spines and fine secondary spines.

reef-block.prompt: High three-quarter angular reef-margin limestone breccia block with fractured faces, chipped margins and embedded coral and shell fragments.

neocalamites.prompt: Complete Neocalamites stand with clustered rhizome base, five to seven jointed stems of varied height and sparse narrow leaf whorls at nodes.

pleuromeia.prompt: Early Triassic Pleuromeia with bulbous roots, one unbranched leaf-scarred stem, simple strap-leaf crown and one central cone; no palm leaflets.

bjuvia.prompt: Complete low Bjuvia cycadophyte with broad roots, short armored stem and dense radial rosette of long stiff pinnate fronds.

shore-boulder.prompt: High three-quarter single red-sandstone shore boulder with broad base, sedimentary bedding, softened angular fractures and wave-cut grooves.
